title: IT Helpdesk Analyst Apprentice
description:
Start your IT Support career with Aberdein Considine!

The IT Helpdesk Analyst will be responsible for delivering a high-quality service in line with the firm's policies and procedures. They will consistently demonstrate values driven behaviour by showing genuine care for clients and colleagues, striving for excellence through going above and beyond and fostering a culture of collaboration and teamwork.

Responsibilities:
- Providing effective 1st line technical support by diagnosing, resolving and escalating technical issues or bugs appropriately
- Assist with troubleshooting, maintaining, developing and enhancing key systems or applications
- Assist with maintaining and improving existing systems to ensure reliability and performance
- Installing, configuring, developing and supporting IT assets (software and hardware) to ensure users are equipped to perform their roles effectively
- Working collaboratively between specialised IT teams to maintain agreed service delivery standards
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date technical documentation for processes, common tasks, applications, integrations and changes

Required skills:
- Driving licence
- Ability to think logically and systematically
- Strong customer service skills
- Newly qualified or demonstrable experience in applicable IT
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Excellent organisational skills
- High levels of accuracy with an eye for detail
- Customer service driven approach to working is imperative
- Logical and methodical approach to troubleshooting

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 8:45am - 5pm

Benefits:
- Pension
- Life assurance
- Private medical
- 35 days holidays
- Flexible working

Future prospects:

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

Important information:

This vocational apprenticeship comprehensively supports your specific job role with this particular employer. Throughout your learning journey, you are fully supported by your dedicated QA skills coach and your mentor at work. They ensure you settle in, help you develop all the skills you need to be successful in your job role and pass your assessments, and can provide one to one support.

Starting with insights into your current potential, they plan your growth in a programmatic way, close skills gaps with immersive training and ensure what you learn is applicable to what you do. They talk you through the specifics on the qualifications you gain and how they align in particular to your day to day role.

On completion, as well as the valuable work experience you have gained, you get a nationally recognised qualification at SCQF Level 8.

If you are interested in starting your career and receiving a work based qualification at the same time APPLY NOW!

title: Admin Assistant
description:
Your new company

Hays are delighted to be supporting a well-established organisation in Inverness with the recruitment of a Temporary Admin Assistant for an initial period of up to 12 weeks. This is a varied and fast-paced position that would suit an experienced administrator who enjoys supporting different areas of the business and takes pride in delivering a high standard of service. This role is fully office-based and offers an immediate start.

Your new role

As Admin Assistant, you will provide essential administrative support across the office, ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of operations. Your duties will be varied and will include welcoming visitors and providing a professional first point of contact, managing shared inboxes, coordinating correspondence, and supporting meetings through minute taking and note preparation. You will also assist with a range of HR administration tasks, process and code invoices accurately, order office stationery and supplies, and provide administrative support relating to the maintenance and management of office facilities. Document management will form an important part of the role, requiring the use of SharePoint and other Microsoft applications to maintain accurate records and ensure information is stored correctly and in line with organisational procedures.This is a broad and hands-on position that requires someone who is confident working across multiple administrative functions and can manage competing priorities effectively.
What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you will have previous experience working in a busy office-based administrative position and be comfortable undertaking a wide variety of tasks. You will possess excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records and data integrity.You will have strong Microsoft Office skills, including experience using Outlook, Word, Excel and SharePoint for document management. Strong communication skills are essential, along with the ability to work independently, use initiative and build positive relationships with colleagues, visitors and external contacts. This role also requires you to hold a current Disclosure Scotland or to apply for one prior to the start date.

What you'll get in return

In return, you will have the opportunity to join a supportive team environment and gain valuable experience within a varied administrative role. This temporary assignment offers an immediate start and the chance to contribute to a busy organisation during an important period of support.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call Julie at Hays on (phone number removed).
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Administrator
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

A well-established organisation based in Inverness is seeking an experienced and proactive Administrator to join their team on a temporary basis for an initial 3-month contract. Working within a small and supportive office environment, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the business while providing excellent administrative support across a variety of functions.

Your new role

This is a varied and busy administration position where no two days will be the same. You will be responsible for managing general office administration, handling incoming telephone and email enquiries, maintaining accurate records and databases, and providing support with document preparation, filing, data entry and scheduling. You will also welcome visitors to the office, respond to customer and stakeholder queries, and assist colleagues with a range of administrative tasks as required.Working closely with a small team, you will be an important point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders, helping to ensure a professional and efficient service is delivered at all times. This role is fully office-based and would suit someone who enjoys working collaboratively, is highly organised and takes pride in delivering a high standard of administrative support.

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you will have previous administration experience and strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage a varied workload and prioritise effectively. You will be confident communicating with a range of people, both face-to-face and over the telephone, and possess strong written and verbal communication skills. Good IT skills, including experience using Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel and Outlook, are essential. A professional approach, keen attention to detail and a positive, team-focused attitude will also be key to your success. You must also be happy to work in the office every day, Monday to Friday, as this role does not offer hybrid working.

What you'll get in return

In return, you will have the opportunity to gain valuable experience within a respected organisation while working as part of a friendly and supportive team. This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced administrator available to start at short notice and looking for a varied temporary assignment in Inverness.

What you need to do now
